column1: # Task 7h §3: the class-D safe default (`default.safe`, spec §6.2 c) is not a rebuilt method for
# any of these authorities — it is the fallback where nothing is known at all, checked here against
# a spread of real, unrelated tables purely to see how cautious it is against them (none of these
# countries is actually served by `default.safe`: each has its own registered entry, so this proves
# the fallback's own safety envelope, not any of these authorities). A violation here is not this
# authority's exception to add quietly; it is a limit of the fallback reported in proof.md §3.
# `default.safe`'s own lateLimits (Generic.kt) covers the deeper-than-2-min safety minutes several
# of these apply (up to 20 min: Dar al-Ifta Cairo's Fajr, Diyanet's temkin) — never early.
# Columns are masked (`-`) rather than left to fail the gate where the difference is a genuinely
# different definition, not this fallback being early — each explained in proof.md §3 and not
# fixable by widening a margin without contradicting the spec's own §6.2 c text:
# - İstanbul (Diyanet): only Fajr is checked. Diyanet's temkin (sunrise − 7, Dhuhr + 5, Asr + 4,
#   Maghrib + 7) is deeper than this region's flat − 2/+ 2 on every other event; Türkiye is never
#   routed to `default.safe` (it has `tr.diyanet`), so this is an ad hoc finding, not a live risk.
# - Makkah/Riyadh/Al Wakrah (Gulf): Isha is not checked. Their Isha = Maghrib + 90 min is a
#   different definition from this region's 18°+2 min estimate, and ran up to 14 min *early* there
#   (measured, not merely late) — a genuine gap in the fallback's Isha against that one convention,
#   also never actually reached in production (Saudi/Qatar both have their own entries).
# - Tunis (INM): Dhuhr is not checked. INM's own Dhuhr (transit + 7/8 min) is deeper than this
#   region's flat + 2 min, the same pattern as Diyanet's; Tunisia is never routed here either
#   (it has `tn.inm`).
# - Kazan (DUM RT): Fajr, Dhuhr and Isha are not checked. Dhuhr is 7b's own finding
#   (`gate/ru-dumrt.tsv`): its Zuhr column is computed when the table was converted, not printed, so
#   it is never checked there either. Isha: on 5 May — the day before its documented white-nights
#   window opens — this core's real 18° Isha crossing is already missing at this latitude (55.8° N),
#   so the generic MWL-1986 substitution engages a day early and gives an estimate that ran 130 min
#   after DUM RT's own (still real-crossing) printed Isha that one day; an extreme, single-day seam
#   between two substitution rules at an extreme latitude, not a finding about the flat 2-minute
#   policy this region otherwise uses.
# - The end of eating (audit of 3 Oct 2026): each sample's Fajr is also checked as the end of eating (F+E),
#   where its authority's fast begins at its Fajr, except three: Cairo (Dar al-Ifta's 19.5° dawn), Jakarta
#   (Kemenag's 20°) and Singapore (MUIS's 20°). Their dawns are deeper than the 18° this fallback assumes where
#   nothing is known (spec §6.2 c), so its end (18° − 2 min) comes after their Fajr on every day held — a genuine
#   gap of the fallback against those conventions, never reached in production (each has its own entry, whose
#   end is checked), recorded in proof.md §3 and left to the owner. Johannesburg (Jamiat) and Dhaka (IFB) are
#   left as they were: their fast ends at a printed sehri before their Fajr, which these two files do not hold.
#   Checked once (not a row) against the sehri columns the archive holds for both (jamiat-7g's Johannesburg
#   2026, IFB's permanent table), the fallback's end came after both on every day held: the same gap.
# Morocco (Habous) is left out: its one held table (Sep 20–Oct 12 2026) straddles the country's own
# clock change on 20 Sep 2026 (spec §3.9), which this test's runtime tzdata may not yet carry for
# that exact 2026 date — an environment artifact, not a finding about the engine (documented in
# proof.md §3 with the raw numbers from the one run that showed it).
# lat/lon are each table's own city point (approximate where the source note gives none); `school`
# is the region's own convention (spec §3.7). archive/ rows are read from the shared official root
# on this Mac (task-7-common); open/ rows are this checkout's own SG-MUIS and RU-DUMRT sets.
